prerequisites: Knowledge of grammar at B2 level
professional vocabulary learnt in the courses TEN1 and TEN2

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the main ideas of complex texts on both concrete and abstract topics, including technical discussions in his/her field of specialisation.
Interact with a degree of fluency and spontaneity.
Explain a viewpoint on a topical issue giving the advantages and disadvantages of various options.
Communicate in English independently at B2 level with the focus on functional language.

assessment_rules: TEN3 is an oral exam where students are interviewed individually. The student's ability to discuss topics connected with study or work in their field is assessed, requiring B2 level fluency, spontaneity, pronunciation, grammar accuracy, and professional vocabulary. The candidate also performs a specific task based on TEN1 and TEN2 courses, demonstrating functional language and specialist vocabulary. To pass the exam, students must earn a minimum of 50% marks.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
